# An illustrative path

The migration guide at `docs/migrating-to-postgres.md` does not exist yet;
`db-07` creates it. An exemption entry covers it until then.

`docs/spec/control-plane.md` is a negative reference: this document names it
in order to say it must never be created.

An upstream citation names a file in someone else's tree:
`apps/v4/registry/styles/x.css`. It is a path by shape, so the exemption list
is what excuses it — the recognition rules deliberately do not.
